name: agenttool-collab
description: Local coordination and optional read-only witness status across agent sessions

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agent sessions with local evidence.
interface.longDescription: Adds separate self-declared presence and credential-bound coordination planes over one local plaintext SQLite journal, including resumable cursors, advisory path claims, reports and challenges, reviewed edit completion, Git checkpoints, refusable handoffs, and read-only status for an optional Zerone witness sidecar. It never contacts a chain or creates an anchor. MCP arguments and results remain visible to the active model provider, and the host still owns agent lifecycle and wake-up.
defaultPrompt: Start credential-bound coordination for these sessions.
List optional self-declared presence without treating it as identity.
Reconcile reports and review completed edit tasks.
Check optional local witness status without contacting a chain.
